Welcome to
Baosi Banikanta Kakati College
Baosi Banikanta Kakati College was established at Nagaon of greater Baosi locality on 25th, July, 1971. This college came into existence as a result of the indefatigable effort of Late Mahendra Mohan Choudhury, a noted freedom fighter, former Chief Minister of Assam and former Governor of Punjab. Baosi was once a seat of diverse cultural and religious activities of Vaishnavite Preacher Mahapurush Srimanta Shankardeva and his disciple Mahapurush Madhabdeva along with Damodardev and Haridev. Then in the late 19" century, Baosi was endowed with a worthy son of Assam, Dr. Banikanta Kakati. Dr. Kakati was a great scholar, linguist, literary critic and academician of great repute. Thus, the name of the college Baosi Banikanta is conflation of 'Baosi' and 'Banikanta Kakati'.
Baosi Banikanta Kakati College is ideally nestled amidst the lush green paddy fields and sylvan serenity, 12 kilometres away from the din and bustle of the urban atmosphere of Barpeta town. 'Gurukulashram'. As this is essentially a rural college, the academic needs of the local populace is given utmost importance.

From the Principal's Desk
Greetings from Baosi Banikanta Kakati College, a dynamic hub for education, ambition, and change. Serving as principal of this prestigious college and working with our students, instructors, guardians, alumni, and society to create a better future is an honor and a privilege for me.
Education today is not confined to textbooks and examinations alone; it is about nurturing creativity, character, confidence, and compassion. In an era of rapid change and global opportunities, our vision is to build a dynamic academic environment where students are empowered with knowledge, skills, values, and the courage to dream big.
